title: Log smooth and log etale morphisms of fs log schemes
statement:
Let $f:(V,M_V)\to(B,M_B)$ be a morphism of locally Noetherian fs log schemes, with charts, group completions and log morphisms as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Write commutative monoids additively. For such a monoid $P$, the monoid ring $\mathbf Z[P]$ consists of finite sums $\sum_{p\in P}a_pz^p$, with $a_p\in\mathbf Z$, coefficientwise addition, and multiplication determined by $z^pz^q=z^{p+q}$ and $1=z^0$. Spectra and the contravariant maps they induce are as in [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

Etale-local compatible chart data for $f$ mean a family of commutative squares $f_i:V_i\to B_i$ over $f:V\to B$, where $V_i\to V$ and $B_i\to B$ are etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the images of the $V_i$ cover $V$, together with fine saturated monoids $P_i,Q_i$, charts $P_i\to M_{B_i}$ and $Q_i\to M_{V_i}$ for the pulled-back log structures, and a monoid homomorphism $u_i:P_i\to Q_i$ compatible with $f_i$ and its map of log structures. A chart $P_i\to M_{B_i}$ yields a scheme morphism $b_i:B_i\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[P_i]$, the morphism corresponding by [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme] to the ring map $\mathbf Z[P_i]\to\Gamma(B_i,\mathcal O_{B_i})$ sending $z^p$ to the image of $p$ under the structure map; likewise write $a_i:V_i\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[Q_i]$. Compatibility of $u_i$ with $f_i$ gives $f_i^\sharp$ of the image of $p$ equal to the image of $u_i(p)$, hence, by the same bijection, $b_i f_i=\operatorname{Spec}(\mathbf Z[u_i])a_i$, where $\mathbf Z[u_i](z^p)=z^{u_i(p)}$. Thus there is a comparison morphism
$$c_i=(f_i,a_i):V_i\longrightarrow B_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[P_i]}\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[Q_i],$$
using the scheme fibre product of [def-pc-fibre-product].

Put $K_i=\ker(u_i^{\rm gp}:P_i^{\rm gp}\to Q_i^{\rm gp})$ and $C_i=Q_i^{\rm gp}/u_i^{\rm gp}(P_i^{\rm gp})$. The torsion subgroup is $(C_i)_{\rm tors}=\{c\in C_i: nc=0\text{ for some integer }n>0\}$. A finite group's order is invertible on $V_i$ when its image in every local ring of $V_i$ is a unit. The morphism $f$ is called log smooth if such chart data exist with $K_i$ and $(C_i)_{\rm tors}$ finite of orders invertible on $V_i$ and every $c_i$ smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. It is called log etale if such chart data exist with $K_i$ and the whole $C_i$ finite of orders invertible on $V_i$ and every $c_i$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

More precisely: Expose XVI, section 3.7 second paragraph through its last paragraph, printed pp.254--255: semistable G-alteration, ell-Sylow H, tame equivariant modification, quotient over T=S prime/H, and log resolution. Geometric construction only, before applying Theorem 3.6.2 and Proposition 3.5.7; preliminary finite extension to normalize constants in the first paragraph. Specifically: The fs charts used in XVI 3.7 for the semistable model, tame trait change and log resolution.
